title: Google\Cloud\Vision\V1\ReferenceImage
name: ReferenceImage
description: A ReferenceImage represents a product image and its associated metadata, such as bounding boxes.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.name
params.description: The resource name of the reference image. Format is: projects/PROJECT_ID/locations/LOC_ID/products/PRODUCT_ID/referenceImages/IMAGE_ID. This field is ignored when creating a reference image.

params.name: data.uri
params.description: Required. The Google Cloud Storage URI of the reference image. The URI must start with gs://.

params.name: data.bounding_polys
params.description: Optional. Bounding polygons around the areas of interest in the reference image. If this field is empty, the system will try to detect regions of interest. At most 10 bounding polygons will be used. The provided shape is converted into a non-rotated rectangle. Once converted, the small edge of the rectangle must be greater than or equal to 300 pixels. The aspect ratio must be 1:4 or less (i.e. 1:3 is ok; 1:5 is not).

methods.name: getName
methods.description: The resource name of the reference image.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: The resource name of the reference image.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Required. The Google Cloud Storage URI of the reference image.

methods.name: setUri
methods.description: Required. The Google Cloud Storage URI of the reference image.

methods.name: getBoundingPolys
methods.description: Optional. Bounding polygons around the areas of interest in the reference image.

methods.name: setBoundingPolys
methods.description: Optional. Bounding polygons around the areas of interest in the reference image.
